text:
sarah: Heads-up — invoice preview jumped for a few tenants this morning. Looks correlated with SKU-binding changes + quota heartbeat spikes. Console shows preview credits disappearing then reappearing :confused:

miguel: oof. do you have a tenant id or sample events?

sarah: tenant=acme-inc, trace id `trace-7b9f`. here's a snippet from the ingest log around the time:
```
2024-10-12T09:02:11Z INFO route-resolver resolve route_attr sku=prod-us -> route:r3
2024-10-12T09:02:11Z WARN quota-heartbeat missing for tenant=acme-inc window=1m
2024-10-12T09:02:12Z INFO metering-event emitted tokens=124 route=r3 fingerprint=fp-abc
```

jana: can we repro locally with a small canary? this feels like race between route binding update and heartbeat aggregator.

alex: quick theory: when sku binding changes mid-session we neuter the prefix/KV cache and the TTL on the quota-heartbeat gets reset, which causes the tallying job to create a transient orphan ledger entry. invoice preview dedupe looks at route_attr + fingerprint; if route_attr flips, dedupe misses and preview shows 0 then later corrects.

miguel: that matches what i saw in the traces. confirmed fingerprint stays the same but `route_resolution_id` changed. dedupe key currently: `tenant|fingerprint|route_resolution_id`.

sarah: ugh. so by tying dedupe to route_resolution_id we get spurious gaps when routing policy changes. should we move to dedupe key without route id?

pm-elena: tradeoff: removing route id will merge events across route variants -> could hide legitimate duplicates from retries. UX asked for per-route previews to help product teams see cost by SKU.

alex: proposal: keep per-route visibility but add a short-lived canonical mapping. i.e. when route flips within a session mark events as alias -> canonical_route for preview window (60s). dedupe uses canonical_route. pseudocode:
```
if route_flip && within_session: canonical = previous_route else canonical = current_route
key = tenant|fingerprint|canonical
```

jana: that buys us short window correctness while preserving per-route accounting outside the window. needs change to aggregation window + console annotation.

miguel: also seeing a telemetry spike on heartbeat jitter at the same time — http://dashboards/heartbeat?range=1h (link) :eyes:

ingest-bot: NOTICE: 1719999999 - partition-4 backlog spike 09:01-09:05, consumer-lag max=14s

ops-bot: alert suppressed (runbook #42) — routing rebinds observed during deploy window.

sarah: ok next steps: (1) quick patch to dedupe canonicalization for invoice preview only (canary) (2) add console annotation showing "preview uses canonicalized route for 60s" (3) add telemetry counter: route_flip_alias_count and expose in per-tenant preview panel

pm-elena: +1 on annotation. product wants clarity rather than surprising zeros.

alex: i'll open a PR with the patch and tests. will ping @eng-platform when canary is up.

miguel: assign me for telemetry and dashboard panel. i'll add a small gauge and a log event `route_flip_alias` with sample keys.

jana: devex note: need to update docs about dedupe key semantics for preview vs billing (billing will remain strict).

sarah: thanks team. if we can get a canary before EOD that reduces support cases. :thumbsup:
